settings.title: What Our SCEGA Conference Permit Service Covers

settings.editor: We agree the application tasks with your team before work begins. You know what SYNC coordinates, which information you provide and which decisions remain with the authority.

background_image.alt: Reviewing documents for a SCEGA event permit application

settings.editor: SYNC reviews the conference format, organizing entity and accompanying activities to identify the applicable route and outstanding eligibility questions. Your team provides the event brief and accurate entity and applicant information; the authority confirms eligibility and licensing requirements.

We help organize the programme, speaker information, venue details and supporting documents, and check the file for gaps and inconsistencies. Your team supplies the requested records, authorizations and final confirmation that the information is accurate.

We coordinate the agreed submission tasks, attachments and application information through the appropriate process. Your team provides the necessary authorization and approvals for us to support the application; SCEGA receives and assesses it.

We track requests for clarification and help coordinate corrected information or additional documents during review. Your team responds to outstanding questions and approves material changes before they are submitted.

If the dates, venue, programme or event scope change, we help review the relevant amendment or cancellation steps. Tell us as soon as plans change so any authority requirements, revised documents or applicable charges can be checked.
